lineage.core_design: tagged beacon migration and staged departure chronology

chapters.title: Shoreglass dissemination rule
chapters.body: Before first light, the named sealed Shoreglass brief is the sole and exhaustive dissemination channel for the route stating that flock Delta goes to Marrow Quay. In that period, a person knows that route only after signing for Shoreglass; oral recitation, copied extracts, and all other route transmissions are prohibited.

chapters.title: Shoreglass delivery register
chapters.body: At 05:40, before first light, the register records the sealed Shoreglass brief delivered only to Vela Mar; Oren Sile has no delivery or receipt entry.

chapters.title: North-Chime convention
chapters.body: A beacon departure entry tagged North Chime denotes a departure after the harbor lamps are lit.

chapters.title: Beacon departure tag
chapters.body: The watch book tags the brass beacons' departure entry North Chime.

chapters.title: Wing tally
chapters.body: The east flock tally contains twenty-one brass beacons.

chapters.title: Mooring thread
chapters.body: Each beacon cradle is tied with green hemp thread during the quiet watch.

chapters.title: Blurred barge image
chapters.body: A blurred quay image shows a covered barge, but its cargo mark and departure time cannot be read.

chapters.title: Unsigned wing repair
chapters.body: A repair card confirms a wing was mended but leaves the beacon identifier blank.
